'''Yurie Kobori''' (Japanese: '''小堀友里絵''' ''Kobori Yurie'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kobori was born on July 19, 1983, in {{wp|Fukushima, Fukushima}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She provided the voice of {{an|Shauna}}, {{an|Serena}}'s main [[rival]] in [[Pokémon Showcase]]s, during {{aniseries|XY}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. Kobori is currently affiliated with Air Agency.
